steps.what: Observe and monitor children's play activities and remain ready to intervene

tasks.design: Retain direct play observation and the worker's readiness to respond. Existing care arrangements in {DOCS} remain support; no camera, inferred emotion label or automated safety monitor is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task requires an adult to notice context and act immediately.
tasks.enabler_now: No technology change is required for the unchanged supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle changes in play, emerging hazards and competing needs.
tasks.human_edge: Know when to let play develop and when to intervene.
tasks.altitude: Observation time and supervision responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Review a recurring hazard in the play environment

evidence.claim: Direct play monitoring includes contextual observation and readiness to act that a diary app does not replace.

assumptions: Boundary is live monitoring, not writing the daily diary or performing later care actions.
Worker produces observations directly during s1 with all 100 hours retained. No structured safety flag or automated judgement is assumed.
Existing care instructions are unchanged. Native document access is sufficient, and zero incremental upkeep follows from no new tool, record or monitoring process.
research_questions: Which moments require direct observation beyond information available in a daily diary?

already_counted.description: Observe play and remain ready to respond

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and net zero. Retain direct supervision; no reduction is claimed from replacing an adult with a digital monitor.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Communicate daily activities and concerns with parents

steps.what: Select accurate daily activities and observations appropriate for the child's parent or guardian
Prepare and send routine daily activity updates to the appropriate parents or guardians
Discuss children's activities, behaviours and related issues with parents and answer their questions

tasks.design: Use the parent diary category of {OTHER} to reuse selected daily records instead of copying them into separate messages. The worker checks the exact update and recipients before sending, and keeps all sensitive discussion and questions human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine information is repeated across diary notes and parent messages, while concerns need a real conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native parent diary timelines can reuse existing care entries under restricted access.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding what to share and discussing a concern without misrepresenting the child.
tasks.human_edge: Listen to the parent's perspective and explain context sensitively.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated routine message assembly; parent relationships and care decisions stay human.

reach.task: Help resolve a concern raised during a parent discussion

evidence.claim: Konnect OuderApp provides a parent timeline, daily report, digital diary and agenda; this supports reusing routine entries for parents, not automating sensitive conversation.

assumptions: Boundary is worker preparation and parent communication, not creating the original care record or parent reading time. Overlapping diary work must be allocated once in roll-ups.

Care worker produces the original child id, date, activity and observation entry under the existing record-keeping task, with capture time counted there and unchanged here. In s1 the focal worker checks and selects those entries and the intended audience with all 20 hours retained.

Administrator already maintains verified guardian identity and access arrangements; s1 checks the current recipient mapping. New access or consent changes are charged below. Missing or uncertain access means manual verification and no send.
s2 retains 15 hours for wording, privacy, recipient checks and manual exceptions. No model invents a behaviour explanation or generalises a daily event.
Test native diary sharing before custom messaging. Approval binds the complete message and recipients; edits require confirmation again. Sensitive conversations retain their full 55 hours.
unknowns: Kinds of concerns requiring a conversation
research_questions: Does reusing selected diary entries reduce copying without increasing wrong-recipient or context errors?

already_counted.description: Select records, verify and send updates and discuss concerns with parents

incremental.description: Check sharing templates and changed guardian access or consent arrangements

approvals.approved_version: Final update revision with selected entries, complete text and verified recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+15+55=90; gross 10 less upkeep 1 gives net 9. E1 scenario saves 40% of routine message assembly only; existing diary sharing or complex family issues may leave no gain. Conversations and original record capture stay counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Support children's emotional and social development

steps.what: Support children's emotional and social development, encourage understanding of others and positive self-concepts

tasks.design: Keep reassurance, encouragement and guided social interaction with the childcare worker. Existing care guidance in {DOCS} can inform practice, without an automated emotional profile or substitute relationship.
tasks.previous_blocker: Support depends on trust, timing and a child's immediate context.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change is needed for this unchanged relational work.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing when to comfort, encourage independence or help children understand one another.
tasks.human_edge: Build trust through consistent, sensitive interaction.
tasks.altitude: Support time and care responsibilities stay unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss a recurring interaction difficulty and agree consistent adult responses
reach.learn: Reflective care practice and role limits

evidence.claim: Responsive social and emotional support is relational work retained with the caregiver in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is everyday responsive care, not diagnosis, formal developmental assessment or specialist intervention.
Worker hears and observes children's interactions during the retained step. No structured emotional label, camera inference or machine action is introduced.
Existing guidance remains sufficient; no software build is proposed. Zero incremental upkeep because there is no new data collection or automated support process.
unknowns: Current support arrangements and escalation routes
research_questions: Where do workers need peer reflection or additional human support rather than another digital artefact?

already_counted.description: Provide responsive emotional and social support

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and net zero. Retain every moment of direct support; no saving is claimed by shortening relationships or shifting care to another worker.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep individual children's daily care records

steps.what: Capture daily observations, activities, meals served and medications actually administered for each child
Copy child observations and care information into the individual daily record
Check daily child records for identity, completeness and factual accuracy
File the checked care records for authorised retrieval and handover

tasks.design: Enter each event directly into the childcare-record category of {OTHER}, making it the individual record rather than copying a notebook into {DOCS}. Use native restricted filing and retrieval, while keeping primary capture, medication fact checks and record corrections with the worker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Care facts are first noted and then copied or filed separately, risking omission and identity errors.
tasks.enabler_now: A native individual diary can hold the original event with controlled access.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate child association, late entries and distinguishing administration from a planned medication.
tasks.human_edge: Know what actually happened and challenge an inaccurate care entry.
tasks.altitude: Less copying and filing; responsibility for factual care records stays human.

reach.task: Resolve a missing or conflicting daily-care entry
reach.learn: Record provenance, correction and restricted access

evidence.claim: Konnect OuderApp supports a daily report and digital diary, demonstrating a digital daily-record capability; the digest does not establish medication-administration functionality.
Direct individual event entry and native filing can remove duplicate copying while retaining original capture and verification.

assumptions: Boundary is record keeping after or alongside care, not observing play, preparing meals, administering medication, authorising medication or sharing the full record with parents.

Worker produces child id, event date and time, event type, factual note and actual meal or activity details in s1; for an administered medication entry, actual product, quantity with unit, administration time and administering practitioner identity come from the person who administered it. In the focal-worker scenario all capture and confirmation are inside s1's retained 45 hours.

If another practitioner administered medication, they already produce the existing original administration entry outside this task; its unchanged capture time is not saved. The focal worker checks its provenance in s1 and never infers administration from a schedule.

Direct s1 entry is the updated daily record, so s2 duplicate copying disappears without a second producer. s3 retains all 20 hours for identity, source and missing-entry checks. Corrections keep provenance.

Test native daily records and restricted filing first. Medication entries require existing approved record facilities; if absent, retain that separate manual record and use the lower scenario. No general chatbot receives child health data.
s4 retains 5 hours for access and handover exceptions. New form and access maintenance is costed below; any parent sharing is a separate checked action.
research_questions: Can original event capture serve the required individual record without losing provenance or weakening medication-entry checks?

already_counted.description: Capture original care events, check facts and handle filing exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain entry forms, restricted access mappings and failed filing checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+0+20+5=70; gross 30 less upkeep 2 gives net 28. E1 scenario removes duplicate copying and half the filing effort only. Existing direct entry or separate approved medication records may leave no additional gain; original capture and verification are fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The worker can reduce duplicate diary entry and routine message assembly while retaining observation, personal support and sensitive parent discussions.
reach: Clarify parent communication access and context
role.ambitious_version: A caregiver who records facts once and uses the recovered clerical time without reducing direct attention to children.
